registration.statement: Oxidative addition preserves one or two metal occurrences and two distinct covalently bound carriers while replacing the carrier-carrier bond by two metal-carrier incidences. Exact positive electron transfer is held as two on one metal or one on each of two metals, never as signed oxidation.
